verdict.rationale: Swell provides a documented CLI (`swell app init`, verified installable and versioned via npm), official Node/PHP SDKs, app scaffolding (models/, functions, themes), webhooks, and a distribution path via storefront apps like Proxima and a Claude Code skills marketplace. Missing for 10: no explicit formal app review/approval process documented, and no public app marketplace/listing submission workflow beyond the Proxima example.
